list.title: Chats
list.searchPlaceholder: Search title, first prompt, project, id…
list.stateAllHint: Every chat, whatever it is doing
list.stateWorkingHint: A process is generating or running tools
list.stateWaitingHint: Stopped for a permission, a question or a plan
list.workersHint: The chats that carry out the tasks of an orchestration: their home is the orchestration board
list.internalHint: Housekeeping chats of Agentry itself (the planner, the auth check)
list.emptyFilteredBody: Nothing in this list matches the search or the filters in force.
list.emptyBody: Chats you start here, and the ones your agents have run in an imported project, appear in this list.
list.keysHint: j / k to move · Enter to open · x to select · / to search

bulk.deleteBody_one: Its transcript is deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
bulk.deleteBody_other: Their transcripts are deleted with them. This cannot be undone.
bulk.skipIntro_one: This one is left as it is:
bulk.skipIntro_other: These {{count}} are left as they are:
bulk.nothingTitle: None of these chats can be deleted now

new.title: New chat
new.subtitle: Starts a conversation with {{agent}} that Agentry keeps
new.promptHint: Drop or paste files onto the prompt to attach them.
new.agentHint: The model and the permission modes are the chosen agent's
new.modelHint: Alias or full model id. Empty = CLI default
new.modelLocked: {{agent}} picks the model when the chat starts
new.permissionModeHint: Can be changed while the chat works
new.askHere: Answer permission prompts, questions and plans from the panel (off: whatever would ask is denied)

examples.one: Read this project and tell me how it is laid out
examples.two: Find where the retries are handled and explain the policy
examples.three: Add a test for the case where the file is missing

runWorkflow.argsHint: Optional: handed to the script as `args` (text or JSON)
runWorkflow.modelHint: For the chat that launches it; the script can pick its own per agent
runWorkflow.intro: Scripts in the project's .claude/workflows/ and in your own. Running one starts a chat that launches it, so its prompts come to this panel.
runWorkflow.emptyBody: Save one from a chat with the Workflow tool, or write a script in .claude/workflows/.

limit.title: {{name}} reached its usage limit
limit.resetUnknown: The reset time is not known · last reading {{age}}
limit.waitingNote: Then your last message is sent again in this same chat.
limit.waitFailed: The wait could not be set
limit.moveNowNone: No other provider can take this chat now
limit.stopWaitingFailed: The wait could not be stopped
limit.note: Continue takes a summary of what was done to {{name}}. Start over repeats your original request. Both work in the same folder, and nothing is sent to another program unless you choose it.
limit.noteWait: Nothing is sent to another program unless you choose it.
limit.capped: This work has already moved as many times as the settings allow, so it can only wait.

excluded.not-ready: not signed in, or not installed on this computer
excluded.policy: cannot keep this chat's tool rules
excluded.policy-not-portable: this chat's own tool rules do not carry over
excluded.no-mapping: no counterpart is set for this chat's model
excluded.left-already: this work already left it and its limit has not reset
excluded.not-in-order: not in this project's provider order

composer.limit: Choose what to do with this chat to go on

sheet.title: Continue on {{name}}
sheet.intro: This is how {{name}} will receive the work of this chat.
sheet.introRestart: {{name}} will start from your original request.
sheet.modelMapped: The counterpart you set in Settings
sheet.permissionsHint: The same mode when {{name}} offers it; otherwise it asks first
sheet.folderHint: The same one, with the unsaved changes
sheet.loadFailed: The handoff could not be built
sheet.noPrompt: This chat has no first message to repeat.
sheet.callout: The session and context of {{from}} do not pass to {{to}}: it only knows this text. Nothing has been sent yet.
sheet.foot: A new chat is created and this one stays linked to it.
sheet.moveFailed: The chat could not be moved
sheet.none: No provider can take this chat now.

handoff.title: Handoff from {{name}}
handoff.sub: What {{to}} received as its first message: what was asked, what was done, where the work stood and what was left.

flowMoved.title: This run continues here from {{name}}.
flowMoved.handoff: {{name}} reached its limit and the work went on in {{to}}, with a handoff. It is still the same flow run.
flowMoved.restart: {{name}} reached its limit and the work started over in {{to}}. It is still the same flow run.
